def compute_features(text):

    num_sentences = max(len(sentences), 1)
    words = text.split()
    num_words = len(words)
    avg_sent_len = num_words / num_sentences
    fk = textstat.flesch_kincaid_grade(text)
    return {"word_count": num_words, "sentence_length": avg_sent_len, "fk_grade": fk}

    return np.mean(x) / max(np.std(x, ddof=1), 1e-10)

    return rows
